permissions.name: dsh-composer-ux.fs.read
permissions.reason: Read the plugin's own files under <DSH_HOME>: quick-prompts.json, optimizer state, and the profile's settings document to resolve this plugin's config.

permissions.name: dsh-composer-ux.fs.write
permissions.reason: Write only the plugin's own files under <DSH_HOME>: quick-prompts.json, optimizer dock state, and this plugin's own settings namespace. It never writes another plugin's config (the 0.21 request-header write path was replaced by a runtime overlay in 0.22.0).

permissions.name: dsh-composer-ux.process.spawn
permissions.reason: Start the DSH restart helper when the user asks to restart, probe the local Git Bash path for the terminal swap, and (only when the user enables it) run the optimizer's fact-checking shell tool confined by ctx.sandbox.confine or limited to danger-full-access sessions.
